title: Сreate:Connected Vessel compat fix
description: Compatibility hotfix for a server crash caused by Create: Connected Fluid Vessels on Create contraptions hen Destroy included into modpack.
body:
# WARNING! AI-ASSISTED CODING USED!


CC Vessel Fix is a small NeoForge compatibility hotfix for a server crash caused by Create: Connected Fluid Vessels on Create contraptions when using Destroy in modpack.

The crash happens when a fluid transfer tries to fill a mounted Fluid Vessel whose internal `geniusFluidTank` storage is not initialized, causing a `NullPointerException` and crashing the server.

This mod prevents the crash by detecting the broken Fluid Vessel state and safely stopping fluid transfer instead of allowing the server to fail. When the protection triggers, nearby players are warned in chat and should replace the affected Fluid Vessels with regular tanks for normal operation.

Actually , mod also has RU translation :>
